com.elo.device.peripherals

Interface FTDI


  • public interface FTDI
    This interface provides methods by which an application can interact with the FTDi in an Elo View device

        int open(java.lang.String path,
         int baudrate,
         int flags)
        Open the FTDi device at the specified path
        Parameters:
        path - Linux-style path of the device
